sources.modern_18_chart: Repo src/lib/constants.ts super/notVery/noEffect lists, as corrected in corrections_to_constants (4 cells). Modern chart = Gen 6+ chart: Fairy row/col verified against published Gen 6+ chart summaries (Fairy super Fighting/Dragon/Dark; not-very Fire/Poison/Steel; resists Fighting/Bug/Dark; immune Dragon; weak Poison/Steel).
sources.firered_decomp: fresh-start submodule pokefirered-leafgreen, src/battle_main.c gTypeEffectiveness[336], 112 triples parsed; HeartGold sTypeEffectiveness (pokeheartgold src/battle/overlay_12_0224E4FC.c, 112 triples) is identical to FireRed on all 17 shared types (0 diffs).
sources.black2_decomp: fresh-start submodule pokebw2, src/ov167/btl_calc.c GetTypeEffectiveness: type index 17 (placeholder) returns neutral; the effectiveness matrix itself is binary data (data_ov167_021d7500), not a readable source table, so Black 2 is cited as canonical-gen confirmation of the 17-type system, NOT as the parsed matrix. Black 2 predates Fairy, as do FireRed and HeartGold: no decomp on disk contains Fairy cells.
sources.gen6_change_note: Steel lost its Ghost and Dark resistances in Gen 6 (modern: Ghost vs Steel = 1, Dark vs Steel = 1; FireRed/HeartGold/Black 2 era: 0.5). Modern values win per this task (most recent games); this is why Umbral vs Chrome = 1.0 here, not 0.5.
sources.aero_analogue: Aero filled via FLYING analogue only: roster Wind creatures are typed Aero (unification-map.md section 2) and the Mars starting mapping recorded 2026-10-26 is Wind -> Flying. This mapping is PROPOSED, not locked, so every Aero cell carries status analogue-filled, not sourced.
sources.prior_lane: Main src/lib/battleTypeChart.ts (sha bb168160c85fec3e3db5127628e22d129171f4b8, 12 elements, 144 cells, 76 sourced / 24 conflict / 44 owed) is the base this fill supersedes in staging only; its conflict rule (disagreement -> neutral 1.0 flagged, never averaged) is retained, and its OWED Deep cells remain owed here.
